svg.title: The two phases of vector search
svg.desc: Indexing: your data goes through an embedding model and becomes vectors. The system stores the vectors and references in a vector database. Querying: a user query goes through the same embedding model and becomes a query vector. An ANN search compares the query vector with the stored vectors and returns the top-k results.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
